Cases were reported from Srirampura CHC & PHC, Village Mallihalli and Goolihalli, Sub-District Hosdurga, District Chitradurga. Cases presented with loose stools, vomiting, fever and pain abdomen after attending a marriage function on 3rd and 4th May 2025. The affected age group was 10-70 years. Two stool and food samples were collected & sent to VIMS Bellary. Both stool samples did not show growth of Cholera or any other entero-pathogen on culture & microscopy. Water samples were sent to VIMS Bellary, all were found to be fit for drinking purpose. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on control measures, hygiene and sanitation. House to house survey was conducted. IEC done for drinking boiled and filtered water, etc.

Cases were reported from a hostel under UHC Manipal, Village Manipal, Sub- District Udupi, District Udupi. Cases presented with abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea after consuming food and water from A common kitchen on 2-05- 2025. The affected age group was 18-19 years. Three stool samples were sent to District Hospital for culture, all were negative for entero-pathogens like Shigella, Salmonella and Vibrio after 24hrs of aerobic incubation. Six water were sent for testing, out of which 2 were found to be non-potable by MPN test. All cases were treated at District Hospital. District RRT investigated the outbreak. Community awareness and health education given by peripheral team on control measures, hygiene and sanitation.
